name: Dopamine After Dark
overview: Top lawyer Lu Xingyu falls under the control of her stepfather Qin Zhengguo after her father's death. To protect her mother and dignity, she navigates high society as a socialite, until she reunites with her ex Liang Yanzhi, whom she once resented. Past misunderstandings and present struggles intertwine as he wants to rekindle their love, standing by her side to confront adversity head-on in the city.
